description: This file defines classes implementing raw input devices (keyboard, mouse, touchscreen) for the Playwright project, specifically for the BiDi protocol. It includes methods for simulating key presses, mouse movements, clicks, wheel scrolling, and touchscreen taps, interfacing with a BidiSession.

classes.name: RawKeyboardImpl
classes.description: Implements keyboard input methods for the BiDi protocol, including key down, key up, and text sending.

classes.name: RawMouseImpl
classes.description: Implements mouse input methods for the BiDi protocol, including move, down, up, and wheel actions.

classes.name: RawTouchscreenImpl
classes.description: Stub implementation for touchscreen input, with a tap method.

methods.name: keydown
methods.description: Simulates a key down event with modifiers and key name.

methods.name: keyup
methods.description: Simulates a key up event with modifiers and key name.

methods.name: sendText
methods.description: Sends a string of text as key events.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Moves the mouse pointer to specified coordinates.

methods.name: down
methods.description: Simulates pressing a mouse button down.
